description: This file defines the LoadGrain class, which implements a grain for transaction load testing in an Orleans-based distributed system. It manages the generation of transactions, tracks their success or failure, and handles transaction retries.

classes.name: LoadGrain
classes.description: A grain class for performing transaction load generation and reporting in an Orleans environment.

methods.name: Generate
methods.description: Starts the transaction load generation process with specified parameters.

methods.name: TryGetReport
methods.description: Retrieves the current report of transaction results if the generation is complete.

methods.name: RunGeneration
methods.description: Performs the core logic of generating transactions, managing concurrency, and timing.

methods.name: ResolvePending
methods.description: Handles completion and fault detection of pending transaction tasks, updating the report accordingly.

methods.name: StartTransaction
methods.description: Initiates a single transaction via the transaction root grain, with retry logic on failure.
